posts.body:
Hi, does anyone know the name of the outfit/coat/top part of the Female Cloth Type 7 sprite? I need to know so I can do research and have it drawn in a more detailed style. Thanks!
See image attached for reference.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Looks like a blazer/skirt to me.

posts.author: Sword_of_Dusk
posts.body: If not that, a doublet is the other close thing I can find for comparison.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body: I think I agree with Harlekin--that looks to me like a blazer-style jacket with a lot of gold trim. Try the search term "blazer with lapel trim" and see if you like the results!
